title: Passivbot authored v9 configuration
description: Canonical authored JSON, including sparse policy. Defaults are annotations, never inserted. Runtime validators own cross-field, strategy activation, native numeric, market and dataset rules. Result records, runtime metadata and configuration aliases are outside this schema.

score_hysteresis_margin.description: Absolute challenger-minus-incumbent ranking score margin required for replacement.

drawdown_ratio_ema_span_minutes.description: Floating-point EMA span; native f32 decay representability is validated at load time.

drawdown_ratio_threshold.description: RED requires both current and smoothed drawdown ratios to exceed this threshold.

memory_ema_span_minutes.description: Floating-point EMA span; native f32 decay representability is validated at load time.

max_drawdown_ratio.description: Values at least 1 disable the gate; zero blocks lossy non-panic closes.
max_drawdown_ratio.x-passivbot-denominator: raw balance plus loss-gate remembered drawdown

memory_ema_span_minutes.description: Floating-point EMA span; native f32 decay representability is validated at load time.

approved_coins.description: Shared approval list, all sentinel or reloadable common-list file; sparse config omission approves nothing, while the starter declares its list.

max_minutes.description: Null leaves history warmup uncapped; positive finite values cap its existing calculation.

max_duration_minutes.description: Null means no ceiling; enabled modifier weights require a finite ceiling.

adverse_directionality.description: Additional cooldown minutes per unit modifier.

exposure_ratio.description: Additional cooldown minutes per unit modifier.
exposure_ratio.x-passivbot-denominator: position wallet exposure / effective wallet exposure limit

always_include.description: Persistent side selection within the eligible universe; operational modes and risk gates retain priority.

items.description: Persistent selection identifier; order is retained and duplicates are removed.
